methods.name: Anvil smithing (bronze to steel)
methods.note: Best item for your level at the Varrock west anvil. The Knight's Sword and other quests can skip most of 1 to 39 instead.

methods.name: Dart tips and nails
methods.note: Slow but low attention, 81 seconds an inventory, and usually breaks even or better. About 23% faster in the Smiths' Uniform.

methods.name: Giants' Foundry
methods.note: Forge two-metal alloy swords for Kovac. Rates use the best moulds. Ironmen buy shop warhammers or Blast Furnace ore for the metal.

methods.name: Blast Furnace bars
methods.note: Iron, steel then mithril bars with a coal bag and ice gloves. Slow xp but decent profit. Adamant and runite give no more xp.

methods.name: Steel cannonballs
methods.note: Steel bars at a furnace, 160 seconds an inventory. A double ammo mould from Giants' Foundry doubles it to 27,648 an hour.

methods.name: Blast Furnace gold bars
methods.note: Goldsmith gauntlets for the xp, ice gloves to grab the bars, stamina potions. Only 164k an hour without the gauntlets.

methods.name: Blast Furnace gold (Ordan's ore)
methods.note: Buy gold ore from Ordan, hopping worlds for stock, and smelt in goldsmith gauntlets. About 4 gp per xp. Over 300k if you drop the bars.

methods.name: Platebodies
methods.note: Steel, mithril then adamant platebodies at an anvil by a bank. High alch them to claw back cost. 300k at 88 in the Smiths' Uniform.

methods.name: Rune platelegs, skirts or 2h swords
methods.note: Needs 99, so boost with Kovac's grog from 95 or dwarven stout from 98. Three runite bars each, profitable sold or alched.

unverified: Giants' Foundry: the guides disagree. Bands are the Ironman Guide 'Best Moulds' rows (no Smiths' Uniform). The main guide table, which assumes optimal moulds and optimal play at 81 Smithing, gives 97,920 / 133,920 / 164,640 / 198,000 / 253,110 for the same alloys; the Ironman Guide default-mould rows give 56,290 / 84,430 / 116,980 / 145,860 / 172,520

Platebodies: the main guide gives 144,000 / 200,000 / 240,000; the Ironman Guide gives 150,000 / 200,000 / 250,000 at a flat 4,000 bars an hour. 300,000 at 88 needs the Smiths' Uniform at the Prifddinas anvil

Blast Furnace bars: rates come from Template:Blast Furnace MMG Table (fetched, not in the cache); adamantite at 70 (101,250) and runite at 85 (107,500) are left out of bands because they give no more xp than mithril

Blast Furnace gold bars: needs The Giant Dwarf started (not completed) for Keldagrim, and ice gloves need 50 Mining (boostable); neither is in req. 390,000 with 0-tick banking, 410,000 with the Smithing cape
Blast Furnace gold (Ordan's ore): the Ironman Guide says 'more than 230,000' banking the bars and 'more than 300,000' dropping them, both dependent on shop stock

Dart tips and nails: bands use 1,060 bars an hour without the Smiths' Uniform (1,300 with it); the Tourist Trap is only needed for the dart tips, not the nails; the section heading says levels 20 to 99 but the table starts with bronze dart tips at 4
Anvil smithing (bronze to steel): marked both because the Ironman Guide smiths its own early bars, but it gives no rates of its own
Omitted for lack of a rate: ironman iron dart tips from mined ore (15 to 40), hastae at Otto's Grotto (75/90+), Zalcano (about 3,000 xp an hour plus banked ore)
